# plot_rag_separate_traces { #mofography.visualize.plot_rag_separate_traces }

<span class="mg-tag mg-tag-alternate">alternate</span> Same RAG geometry as plot_rag with separate colored node and edge traces and legend groups.

```python
visualize.plot_rag_separate_traces(G, plot_with='maxima', **kwargs)
```

Plot region adjacency graph with separate traces for nodes and edges.

Args:
    G: NetworkX graph
    plot_with: Node attribute to use for coordinates ('maxima' or other)
    **kwargs: Additional arguments passed to traces
        node_kwargs: Dict of arguments for node trace
        edge_kwargs: Dict of arguments for edge trace
